# HonorElevate.com — White-Labeled AI Systems for Small Business

> HonorElevate is Connor MacIvor's white-labeled GoHighLevel (GHL) reseller business — the AI infrastructure platform for small-business operators who want CRM, marketing automation, voice AI, and lead capture without paying enterprise prices or hiring an internal tech team. Built and operated by a former LAPD motor officer turned 27-year real estate broker turned AI builder. Production-grade. Vertical-specific templates. Operator-supported.

## What HonorElevate is

HonorElevate is a fully white-labeled instance of the GoHighLevel (GHL) platform. Connor MacIvor configures, deploys, and supports it for SMB clients across multiple verticals. Clients get:

- A complete CRM (contacts, opportunities, pipelines)
- Marketing automation (email, SMS, multi-step nurture sequences)
- Voice AI integration (24/7 phone answering and lead qualification — see HireAIVoice.com)
- Landing pages, forms, surveys, calendars, payment processing
- Pre-built vertical templates: HVAC, plumbing, electricians, dental, moving, roofing, med spa, auto repair, real estate
- Direct support from Connor (no offshore call center, no first-line ticket queue)

## Who HonorElevate is for

- Local small business owners (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, dental, etc.) who want enterprise marketing capability without enterprise pricing
- Real estate agents who want a CRM + nurture infrastructure that actually compounds
- Service businesses tired of getting Zillow/Yelp/Google leads they have to chase manually
- Agencies who want to white-label sophisticated AI marketing for their own clients (via Connor's certification program)

## The operator-level distinction

Most agencies that "do AI for SMBs" repackage tools they don't understand. HonorElevate is different:

- Connor built (and maintains in production) 26+ of his own brand sites on the same infrastructure he sells to clients. He has skin in his own game.
- The deploy pipeline that runs HonorElevate has anti-wipe CI safety guards, content-corruption detection, and post-deploy verification — built after Connor's own backup script wiped 5 of his sites and he refused to let it happen again.
- HireAIVoice (Connor's voice AI brand) is running real production calls for paying clients today, not vaporware.
- HonorElevate vertical templates aren't theoretical — there are live demo sites at plumbing.honorelevate.com, rdmoving.honorelevate.com, electricians.honorelevate.com, etc.
